Definition: Kenaz, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kenaz first appears as a son of Eliphaz in Edom, and then as the father of Othniel, who took Debir and won Caleb's daughter Achsah for his wife. The name bridges Esau's line and Judah's first judge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God raises a judge from an unexpected line, and Othniel's courage answers more than his father's name.
RelatedPeople: Kenaz; Othniel, Son of Kenaz; Caleb
